caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects rendered in shades of gray on off-white paper. One object is a three-legged, angular frame with slightly curved ends and a central bracing bar, resembling a stand or trivet. It appears solid and heavy, with a broad, roughly triangular shape and blunt corners. The second object is a long rod with a flat, circular end near the left and an irregularly shaped, slightly curved, pointed end resting on top of the frame near its center. Both objects cast soft shadows beneath them, indicating a light source from above. The drawing is detailed and textured, providing a sense of the rough surface of the metal. The name "ALBERT TAXSON" is neatly written in capital letters at the lower right side of the paper.
title: Flat Iron Holder
